## ⬇ Which file should I download?

| File | Size | |
|---|---|---|
| **AionPingMeter-{{TAG}}-standalone.zip** | {{STANDALONE_SIZE}} | 👍 **Recommended. Not sure? Take this one.** Everything is built in, nothing else to install. |
| **AionPingMeter-{{TAG}}-light.zip** | {{LIGHT_SIZE}} | Tiny version for users who already have the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0). Without it, the app won't start. |

**Both** versions need [**Npcap**](https://npcap.com/#download) (free). During its setup, keep *"Restrict Npcap driver's access to Administrators only"* **unchecked**.

Unzip the archive anywhere and run `AionPingMeter.exe`. If Windows SmartScreen warns you, click **More info → Run anyway**.
